capabilities.name: UK Haulage Fraud & Identity Check
capabilities.description: Cross-references a UK haulage operator's DVSA-declared licence holder name against that company's real, live Companies House officers and persons with significant control (PSC) -- flagging a mismatch, or a recent director/PSC change, the real pattern seen in distressed-acquisition cargo-theft fraud where a haulier's licence still shows the old, legitimate operator while control of the company has quietly changed hands.
representative_queries: does Wincanton's licence holder still match a current Companies House officer
check for a recent director change at this haulier
verify this operator's identity against Companies House officers and PSC

licence_holder_name.description: DVSA-declared licence holder name, e.g. 'Wincanton Limited'.

capabilities.name: Sanctions & PEP Screening
capabilities.description: Screen a name in one call against US OFAC SDN, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and Wikidata-derived Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) data -- with fuzzy name matching, not exact-only. Real competitor research (2026-09-11) found this exact bundle+fuzzy-match shape is what actually converts in this niche; the single-source exact-match ofac-sanctions-search-v1 listing did not.
representative_queries: screen a wallet owner's name before paying them

query.description: Name to screen, for example 'Vladimir Putin' or 'Banco Nacional de Cuba'.

source_ids.description: Fixed sentinel; send exactly this array unchanged. Selects the bundled screening path rather than plain metadata search on the same shared endpoint.

capabilities.name: Christian Scripture Passage Context
capabilities.description: Return a requested verse plus up to ten same-chapter verses before and after from a pinned public-domain corpus.
representative_queries: Show John 3:16 with two verses of context
Return Psalm 23:4 with surrounding WEB verses

capabilities.name: Christian Scripture Keyword Search
capabilities.description: Literal concordance-style search over a pinned public-domain Bible corpus, with bounded source-labelled evidence.
representative_queries: Search WEB for love your enemies

capabilities.name: UK Logistics Operator Risk Check
capabilities.description: Search DVSA's real, live UK Vehicle Operator Licensing register -- every goods vehicle and PSV operator licence in Great Britain (69,127 operators, updated weekly) -- for a haulier or logistics operator by name. Returns licence status, authorised fleet size, and cross-references the operator's real Companies House status to flag a rare but real risk: a licence that still reads valid while the operator's actual registered company is dissolved or in liquidation.
representative_queries: check the goods vehicle licence status for Rhenus
how big is Wincanton's authorised fleet
is this haulier's licence still valid

limit.description: Maximum number of matching operators to return.

query.description: Operator name or substring, e.g. 'Rhenus' or 'Wincanton'.

capabilities.name: Christian Scripture Reading Plan
capabilities.description: Retrieve one bounded day from a deterministic seven-day gospel, psalm-prayer, or practical-wisdom reading plan using source-labelled public-domain Bible text.
representative_queries: Give me day one of the gospel foundations plan
Retrieve day seven of the psalms prayer plan

capabilities.name: Christian Topic Scripture Guide
capabilities.description: Return a bounded, source-labelled set of public-domain Bible passages and neutral reflection prompts for one of six predefined topics.
representative_queries: Give me a scripture guide about hope

capabilities.name: NHTSA Vehicle Recall Search
capabilities.description: Look up official U.S. vehicle safety recalls by make, model, and model year -- campaign number, affected component, defect summary, safety consequence, and remedy. The only source used is the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration's own public API (api.nhtsa.gov). Restricted to recall lookup only for v1; NHTSA safety ratings and complaint records are a different part of the same API family and are not covered.
representative_queries: does a 2020 Honda Accord have any open recalls
check recalls for a specific make/model/year before buying used
safety recall history for a vehicle

capabilities.name: Federal Register Search
capabilities.description: Search U.S. federal regulatory documents -- final rules, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents -- by keyword, document type, issuing agency, and publication date range. The only source used is the Federal Register's own public API (federalregister.gov), published by the National Archives and Records Administration's Office of the Federal Register.
representative_queries: presidential documents mentioning tariffs published this year

query.description: Free-text search term matched against document title/text (e.g. 'data protection', 'tariffs').

document_type.description: RULE=Final Rule, PRORULE=Proposed Rule, NOTICE=Notice, PRESDOCU=Presidential Document.

published_after.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; only documents published on/after this date.

published_before.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; only documents published on/before this date.

capabilities.name: US Weather Forecast & Alerts
capabilities.description: Live multi-day forecast and currently active weather alerts (severe thunderstorm, flood, winter storm, etc.) for a single latitude/longitude point, from the U.S. National Weather Service's own public API (api.weather.gov). Coverage is limited to the United States, its territories, and adjacent coastal/marine zones -- api.weather.gov has no data for points outside that area.
representative_queries: are there any active weather alerts near a given location

periods_limit.description: Number of forecast periods to return (each period is roughly a day or night). Defaults to 5.

include_alerts.description: Whether to include currently active weather alerts for this point. Defaults to true.

capabilities.name: UK Parliament Search
capabilities.description: Search live UK Parliament data: Members (current and former MPs and Peers, by name) and Bills (by title). The only sources used are the UK Parliament's own public Members API (members-api.parliament.uk) and Bills API (bills-api.parliament.uk), both unauthenticated. Votes and Divisions data (a different API family) is out of scope for this version.
representative_queries: find the current MP for a given name
search Parliamentary bills about data protection
list Lords members from a given party

query.description: For search_type=member: a name to search (e.g. 'Starmer'). For search_type=bill: a free-text term matched against bill titles (e.g. 'data protection').

house.description: Member search: filter by House. Bill search: filter by the bill's current House.

current_members_only.description: Member search only. Defaults to false (searches current and former members).

search_type.description: "member" searches current and former MPs/Peers by name. "bill" searches Parliamentary bills by title.

capabilities.name: Christian Scripture Lookup
capabilities.description: Retrieve a bounded passage from the public-domain Berean Standard Bible or World English Bible with exact source labels and provenance.

capabilities.name: Scripture-Grounded Salvation Guide
capabilities.description: Return a deterministic set of source-labelled passages and reflection steps about salvation. The service neither confers nor certifies salvation.
representative_queries: Show a scripture-grounded Christian salvation guide

capabilities.name: Christian Passage Comparison
capabilities.description: Compare a bounded passage in the public-domain BSB and WEB without blending or interpreting the source texts.
representative_queries: Compare Romans 8:1 in BSB and WEB

capabilities.name: Scripture-Grounded Devotional Blessing
capabilities.description: Return a deterministic source-labelled devotional blessing for reflection. Payment buys the structured service, not divine favour or a sacrament.
representative_queries: Give me a scripture-grounded blessing for peace

capabilities.name: Christian Cross References
capabilities.description: Return bounded ranked OpenBible.info cross-reference identifiers with displayed text resolved only from BSB or WEB.

capabilities.name: Private Confession Reflection
capabilities.description: Return a short scripture-grounded private reflection aid. The endpoint accepts no confession narrative or identity information and provides no absolution.
representative_queries: Give me a private scripture reflection for confession

capabilities.name: Extended Guided Confession Reflection
capabilities.description: Return an extended scripture-grounded examination and repair-oriented reflection. It accepts no confession narrative or identity information and provides no absolution.
representative_queries: Give me an extended guided confession reflection

capabilities.name: World Bank WDI Indicator Search
capabilities.description: Search live macroeconomic indicators from the World Bank's World Development Indicators (WDI) database by country and indicator (e.g. GDP, population, inflation, unemployment). Restricted exclusively to WDI, source ID 2 -- the World Bank's own flagship, wholly-owned compiled dataset -- never any of the ~90 other databases the same World Bank API also serves, some of which carry third-party reuse terms. Country and indicator can be given as free text (resolved against the World Bank's own reference lists) or as exact ISO codes / indicator codes.
representative_queries: GDP for the United Kingdom over the last 5 years
population totals for a given country
unemployment rate trend for a country

country.description: A country name, ISO2, or ISO3 code (e.g. 'United Kingdom', 'GB', or 'GBR').

indicator_code.description: Exact WDI indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD.

indicator.description: A WDI indicator name or partial name (e.g. 'GDP', 'Population, total'). Use filters.indicator_code for an exact match.

capabilities.name: Drug/Medicine Metadata Search
capabilities.description: Search live drug and medicine metadata from the U.S. FDA's openFDA API: brand/generic name, active ingredients with strength, dosage form, route, manufacturer/labeler, product type, marketing status, and NDC codes -- plus an optional short (~400 character) label excerpt (purpose or indications only) and an optional recall/enforcement flag. Composed entirely from openFDA's NDC Directory, Drug Label, and Drug Enforcement APIs, all public domain (CC0 1.0 Universal). Never returns full label sections, dosage/administration instructions, drug-interaction or contraindication text, adverse-reaction text, device (GMDN) nomenclature, or personalised medical advice.
representative_queries: find NDC codes and active ingredients for a brand name drug
search generic drugs by active ingredient and dosage form
check whether a drug has an active FDA recall

query.description: Free-text search term (e.g. a brand or generic drug name).

capabilities.name: Clinical Trials Search
capabilities.description: Search live clinical trial records from ClinicalTrials.gov: status, phase, conditions, interventions, lead sponsor, eligibility (sex, age range, a short truncated criteria excerpt), and locations. The only source used is the U.S. National Library of Medicine's public ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, available at no charge. Full eligibility-criteria text, full descriptions, and investigator/recruitment contact details are never returned -- only source-linked, truncated summary metadata.
representative_queries: find recruiting clinical trials for type 2 diabetes
search phase 3 breast cancer trials sponsored by a specific company
clinical trials in France for a given condition

query.description: Free-text search term (e.g. a drug name, condition, or NCT ID).

capabilities.name: Universal Macaroon Search
capabilities.description: Discover which Macaroon Network service, endpoint, or data product to call next. Searches Macaroon's own published catalogue -- title, category, description, price, and trust evidence metadata -- and returns a short, source-linked ranked list plus a safe recommended next call for each match. A thin wrapper over this registry's own existing semantic search and router infrastructure; does not execute matched services, does not call any underlying paid endpoint, and does not duplicate a matched service's own output.
representative_queries: which service checks a domain's trust and DNS setup
find a service for CVE and vulnerability lookups

query.description: Free-text intent, or an exact service_id (e.g. 'cyber-vulnerability-risk-search-v1').

capabilities.name: Grant & Tender Opportunity Search
capabilities.description: Search live UK/EU public procurement tenders and US federal grant opportunities in one call: UK Contracts Finder, UK Find a Tender Service, EU TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), and Grants.gov. Returns source-linked metadata only -- title, buyer/funder, deadline, value, region, category codes, and a link to the original notice -- never full tender documents, specifications, or application forms. Grants.gov is queried live per-request and is never bulk-cached or resold as a stored dataset.
representative_queries: find UK tenders for software services
search US federal grants for climate research

query.description: Free-text keywords (e.g. 'software', 'climate research').

capabilities.name: Cyber Vulnerability Risk Search
capabilities.description: Search CVEs, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities status, and GitHub Security Advisory package/ecosystem metadata in one call. Composes three separately licence-cleared sources: the NVD CVE API (CVSS scoring, descriptions), CVE Program data from cve.org (delivered via NVD), the CISA KEV catalog (CC0 1.0), and the GitHub Security Advisory Database's github-reviewed set (CC-BY-4.0), ingested only via a local git checkout of the public repository -- never the live GitHub Security Advisories API. Does not use OSV.dev, vendor advisory text, or any proprietary vulnerability/exploit database.
representative_queries: is CVE-2021-44228 a known exploited vulnerability
search vulnerabilities affecting an npm package

query.description: A CVE ID (e.g. CVE-2021-44228), a GHSA ID (e.g. GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q), a package name (with filters.ecosystem), or free-text keywords.

capabilities.name: Domain Trust Report
capabilities.description: Single higher-value composite report for one domain: DNS resolution, TLS/SSL certificate validity and issuer, RDAP/WHOIS registration and nameservers, and email deliverability (MX/SPF/DMARC) signals, plus a derived trust score and risk band. Built entirely from already-cleared, already-live internal capabilities (domain-dns-check-v1, domain-ssl-check-v1, domain-whois-lookup-v1, email-domain-deliverability-check-v1) -- no new source, no new licence question, no proprietary reputation database.
representative_queries: give me a full trust report on this domain
check DNS, SSL, WHOIS, and email setup for this domain in one call

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com -- not a full URL.

dkim_selector.description: Optional DKIM selector to check (e.g. 'google', 'selector1'). Without it, DKIM presence is not checked -- only MX/SPF/DMARC.

capabilities.name: Email Deliverability Check
capabilities.description: Checks whether a domain appears technically configured for email delivery, from direct public DNS records only: MX presence, SPF presence, DMARC presence and policy, and an optional DKIM selector check. Queries DNS over HTTPS against a public resolver -- no test emails sent, no mailbox existence verification, no personal data, no leaked-email databases, no proprietary deliverability dataset.
representative_queries: check if a domain has SPF and DMARC set up before outreach
verify a sender domain's email deliverability signals

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com -- not a full URL.

dkim_selector.description: Optional DKIM selector (e.g. 'google', '20161025') to check for a DKIM TXT record. Only checked when supplied.

capabilities.name: Product Safety Recall Search
capabilities.description: Search official product safety recalls and alerts by product or brand keyword, across US FDA (food/drug) and UK OPSS (general product safety) -- the same already-cleared sources composed inside merchant-trust-check-v1, exposed here as a standalone product for use outside a merchant-domain context (e.g. checking a specific product name). EU Safety Gate non-food product alert data is licensed for inclusion (CC BY 4.0) but not yet technically integrated pending a documented access path.
representative_queries: check for product recalls before listing an item
search US FDA and UK OPSS recalls by brand name

query.description: Product name, brand, or manufacturer keyword to search for.

capabilities.name: Government Surplus Auction Search
capabilities.description: Search official US government surplus auction listings -- equipment, vehicles, machinery, scientific equipment, electronics, aircraft, vessels, and other surplus assets -- via the live GSA Auctions API. Returns source-linked listing metadata only: no eBay, third-party auction scrapers, or other marketplace data. GSA Auctions API responses are US federal government works, public domain under 17 U.S.C. Section 105.
representative_queries: find surplus forklifts for sale from the US government
search GSA auctions for scientific equipment or lab instruments
government surplus aircraft or vehicle auctions

query.description: Keyword to search for, e.g. 'forklift', 'microscope', 'aircraft'.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code to narrow results by item/sale location.

capabilities.name: Merchant Trust Check
capabilities.description: Composite trust check for a merchant domain before an agent recommends or transacts with it: live DNS/SSL/RDAP domain signals, same-origin shipping/returns/contact policy-page presence, UK Companies House registration match (GB-only), and US FDA + UK OPSS product recall/safety alert flags. Built entirely from already-cleared internal capabilities and direct, robots.txt-respecting fetches of the merchant's own public pages -- no new third-party licensed dataset. Not a fraud or compliance determination.
representative_queries: is this online store trustworthy before I buy from it
check a merchant's domain, SSL, and published policies

evidence.note: Re-verified after the US FDA + UK OPSS recall extension. First canary (initial launch, before the extension): 0xc2a03d60b4ddc2d116e0cd51bc01d8c914ccf2c41921bb5994a84e2f314af66d.

domain.description: Merchant's bare hostname, e.g. example-store.com -- not a full URL.

country.description: Optional 2-letter country code. Only GB currently enables company_match, via UK Companies House.

company_name.description: Optional merchant legal/trading name, used for company_match and recall_flags lookups.

capabilities.name: Financial Validation: EU VAT Number Check
capabilities.description: Single live pass-through call to the EU Commission's VIES (VAT Information Exchange System) confirming whether an EU VAT registration number is currently valid, with registered name/address when available. Every call is a real-time confirmation only -- never a cached, stored, or aggregated result -- matching VIES's own stated purpose (real-time confirmation of VAT number validity per Council Regulation (EC) No. 904/2010) and how existing commercial VIES-based products already operate.
representative_queries: check if an EU VAT number is valid before invoicing
confirm VAT registration for a B2B counterparty

vat_number.description: VAT number without the country prefix.

country_code.description: 2-letter EU member state code, e.g. IE, DE, FR.

capabilities.name: Financial Validation: IBAN Structural Check
capabilities.description: Offline International Bank Account Number (IBAN) structural and checksum validation (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10) against the published SWIFT IBAN Registry per-country length table. Pure algorithmic validation of a published international standard -- no proprietary bank dataset, no network call, no third-party licence dependency.
representative_queries: validate an IBAN before sending a payment

capabilities.name: Financial Validation: LEI Lookup
capabilities.description: Live Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) lookup via GLEIF's public API: legal name, entity status, jurisdiction, and registration status. GLEIF LEI reference data is published under CC0 1.0 Universal -- commercial reuse, including paid API resale, is explicitly permitted with no attribution requirement.
representative_queries: look up a company's LEI registration
confirm a counterparty's legal entity status before a transaction

capabilities.name: Domain Web Trust: WHOIS/RDAP Lookup
capabilities.description: Part of the Domain Web Trust family: live domain registration lookup via RDAP (RFC 9083), useful for confirming registrar/provenance metadata before an agent interacts with a website or merchant. RDAP is the IANA-standardized, machine-readable successor to legacy WHOIS: reports registration status, registrar, and registration/expiration dates. Queried through the public rdap.org bootstrap redirector at request time -- not a scrape of any single registrar's own WHOIS server, and not a resold third-party dataset.
representative_queries: when does this domain's registration expire

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com -- not a full URL.

capabilities.name: Domain Web Trust: SSL Certificate Check
capabilities.description: Part of the Domain Web Trust family: live TLS handshake against a domain's HTTPS port, useful for confirming a domain has a valid, current certificate before an agent interacts with a website or merchant. Reports certificate validity, issuer/subject, and validity window (including days until expiry). Performed via a real TLS connection at request time -- no third-party certificate-transparency dataset or resale-terms question.
representative_queries: is this domain's SSL certificate valid
check TLS certificate expiry before trusting a site

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com -- not a full URL.

capabilities.name: Domain Web Trust: DNS Check
capabilities.description: Part of the Domain Web Trust family: live DNS resolution check for a domain, useful for confirming a domain has valid DNS before an agent interacts with a website or merchant. Reports whether it resolves and to which IPv4/IPv6 addresses. Queries the public DNS protocol directly at request time -- no third-party dataset, no cached or scraped WHOIS/registry data, so there is no resale-terms question.
representative_queries: DNS check for a domain before trusting a link

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com -- not a full URL.

capabilities.name: WeatherNext Point Forecast
capabilities.description: Point-location weather forecast/reanalysis lookup from Google DeepMind's WeatherNext model via Earth Engine. Every request is bounded to data at least 1 hour old -- the exact license boundary at which WeatherNext data becomes CC BY 4.0 and commercially reusable. This listing never serves data still under the real-time Terms of Use, which explicitly prohibits commercial resale.
representative_queries: WeatherNext point forecast for Tokyo yesterday

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; must resolve to at least 1 hour before the request is made.

capabilities.name: Live UK Company Discovery
capabilities.description: Discover current UK companies through the official Companies House advanced search using bounded filters for company-name inclusion, status, type, incorporation date range, location, and five-digit SIC code. Returns at most 20 normalized company-level public-register records.
representative_queries: find active software companies incorporated since 2024
discover active companies in Manchester by SIC code
find current limited companies whose names include engineering

capabilities.name: Live UK Company Profile & Filing Status
capabilities.description: Fetch current public-register facts for one UK company by exact company number from the official Companies House Public Data API. Returns company status and type, incorporation date, SIC codes, registered-office locality and postcode, and accounts and confirmation-statement due or overdue facts.
representative_queries: check the current filing status for UK company number 12662363
get current Companies House company facts by company number

company_number.description: Exact UK company number; whitespace is normalized server-side.

capabilities.name: Live UK Company Search
capabilities.description: Search current public UK company metadata from the official Companies House Public Data API. Returns a bounded normalized result with company identity, status, type, creation date, registered-address summary, official record link, retrieval time, and content hash.

query.description: UK company name or keyword.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Product Requirements Document
capabilities.description: Generate a bounded implementation-facing product requirements document from a typed brief, with stable requirement identifiers, observable acceptance criteria, explicit unknowns, and unsupported claims kept out of factual requirements.
representative_queries: create a measurable PRD from this typed product brief

input.problem: Operations leads need reliable visibility into delayed jobs.

acceptance.condition: a job has remained queued for 10 minutes

capabilities.name: Live Chain State Snapshot
capabilities.description: Current block number and gas price for Base and Polygon mainnet, fetched live via RPC on every call. Unlike this catalogue's corpus-search listings, this makes a real outbound network call on purchase -- freshness is the product, not a stored snapshot.

capabilities.name: NVD CVE Vulnerability Search (Full Corpus)
capabilities.description: Search the full 100,000-record NVD (NIST) CVE corpus -- description, CVSS base score, and CVSS base severity, harvested directly from the NVD API and confirmed public domain. This is the complete harvested corpus, distinct from the smaller 1,765-record cve-search-v1 listing, which draws from a five-keyword sample cross-referenced with the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list; that KEV cross-reference is not part of this corpus.

query.description: Vulnerability class, product keyword, or CVE ID, for example 'buffer overflow' or 'CVE-1999-0095'.

capabilities.name: UK Property Price Search
capabilities.description: Search recent UK property sale prices from HM Land Registry -- property type, price, town, district, and county. Published under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Address-line fields (postcode, street, house name/number) are deliberately excluded, since Land Registry's own licensing note flags those as carrying a separate Royal Mail restriction beyond the OGL grant on the transaction data itself.

query.description: Property type and/or location, for example 'detached london' or 'flat manchester'.

capabilities.name: SEC Filing Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded snapshot of SEC EDGAR full-text filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) by keyword -- company, CIK, form type, and filing date.

query.description: Keyword or topic, for example 'artificial intelligence' or 'cybersecurity incident'.

capabilities.name: FDA Product Recall Search
capabilities.description: Search recent US FDA food and drug recall enforcement records -- product, manufacturer, reason, and risk classification. Published under CC0 1.0 Universal, explicit commercial reuse permitted. Device recalls deliberately excluded (separately licensed GMDN terminology).

query.description: Product or firm keyword, for example 'injectable' or a manufacturer name.

capabilities.name: World Bank Economic Indicator Search
capabilities.description: Search macroeconomic indicator values (GDP, inflation, unemployment, population) across eight major economies and multiple recent years. Published under CC BY 4.0, explicit commercial reuse permitted.

query.description: Indicator and/or country, for example 'GDP United Kingdom' or 'inflation Brazil'.

capabilities.name: UK Procurement Notice Search
capabilities.description: Search recent UK public-sector procurement notices from Find a Tender -- buyer, value, CPV category, and status. Published under the Open Government Licence v3.0, confirmed directly from the source's own declared package licence.

query.description: Keyword or category, for example 'IT services' or 'construction'.

capabilities.name: CVE Vulnerability Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded snapshot of NVD (NIST) CVE records merged with the complete CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list -- description, CVSS severity, and whether the CVE is known to be actively exploited in the wild.

query.description: Vulnerability class or product keyword, for example 'remote code execution'.

capabilities.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
capabilities.description: Search the full US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list -- name, sanctions programme, and entity type -- for compliance/denied-party screening. Complete 19,199-entry list, not a bounded sample.

query.description: Name or keyword to screen, for example 'Banco Nacional de Cuba'.

capabilities.name: UK Company Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded snapshot of the UK Companies House register -- company name, number, status, category, registered address, and SIC code. Published under the Open Government Licence v3.0, which explicitly permits commercial reuse.

query.description: Company name or keyword, for example 'graphics limited'.

capabilities.name: NIH Research Grant Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded NIH RePORTER snapshot for federally funded biomedical research grants -- title, funded organization, administering NIH institute, award identifiers, and dates -- across every disease area and biomedical discipline, not one narrow field. Metadata only.

query.description: Biomedical research topic, for example 'diabetes' or 'cardiovascular disease'.

capabilities.name: Commercial Use Licence Check
capabilities.description: Check a specific dataset, paper, repository, or model URL against the indexed open-science corpus and receive a conservative, source-linked commercial-use and redistribution status. Never infers permission from an absent or ambiguous licence -- returns unknown rather than guessing.

url.description: URL or DOI link of the dataset, paper, repository, or model to check.

limitation.const: Evidence summary only; not legal advice or a formal compliance determination.

conditions.value: Evidence summary only; not legal advice or a formal compliance determination.

capabilities.name: Crossref DOI Metadata Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded Crossref snapshot for research-paper DOI metadata with stable DOI links, source provenance and conservative linked-work rights fields. Returns metadata only and excludes abstracts and full text.

query.description: Research topic or DOI metadata term, for example 'physics informed neural network'.

capabilities.name: Recent Earthquake Event Search
capabilities.description: Search a bounded, normalized snapshot of significant recent earthquake events with magnitude, time, depth, location, stable USGS links and provenance. Event-level reuse rights remain unknown because ComCat includes contributing seismic networks.

query.description: Location or earthquake search term, for example 'earthquake' or 'Japan'.

capabilities.name: Scientific Model Search
capabilities.description: Find source-linked scientific machine-learning model records by topic. Returns metadata and provenance pointers only; model weights are not downloaded or resold, and missing licence evidence remains unknown.

query.description: Scientific model topic, for example 'PDEBench'.

capabilities.name: Scientific Dataset Search
capabilities.description: Find source-linked scientific datasets by topic. Returns structured metadata pointers, declared licence fields, provenance and freshness without redistributing dataset files.

query.description: Dataset topic, for example 'computational fluid dynamics'.

capabilities.name: Scientific Code Search
capabilities.description: Find source-linked scientific software and repositories by topic. Returns metadata, declared licence evidence and provenance pointers without downloading or reselling repository contents.

query.description: Scientific software topic, for example 'PDE solver'.

capabilities.name: Research Paper Search
capabilities.description: Find source-linked scientific papers by topic. Returns metadata pointers, authors, dates, licence evidence when supplied by the source, and corpus provenance; it does not sell paper text or infer reuse rights.

query.description: Paper topic, for example 'physics informed neural networks'.

capabilities.name: Polymathica Archive Corpus Statistics
capabilities.description: Returns reproducible aggregate statistics for the sanitized Polymathica archive census: 77,053 source rows, unique hashes, domains, file types, readiness and quarantine counts.

capabilities.name: Polymathica Scientific Archive Search
capabilities.description: Search a privacy-safe metadata index derived from 77,053 archived census rows and deduplicated to 23,370 unique content hashes. Includes readiness, quarantine, domain, file type, field names and provenance hashes; does not redistribute raw fields, media or third-party content.

capabilities.name: Polymathica Archive Evidence Record
capabilities.description: Retrieve one sanitized archive metadata record by asset id, including content hash, readiness state, field inventory summary and evidence flags.

capabilities.name: Heated-Channel PINN GPU Job
capabilities.description: Durable asynchronous GPU-job submission. Settlement means the job was accepted and a job_id was returned; it does not mean the eventual PINN result converged or passed validation.
representative_queries: submit heated channel PINN GPU job

validation.scientific_result_gate: evaluated in completed job result, not at submission

capabilities.name: Validated Scientific Solver Index
capabilities.description: Search a governed snapshot of implemented, validated Polymathica PDE and scientific-computing solvers. Returns validation versions, bounded evidence locations, implementation modules and provenance without claiming a fresh solver execution.

query.description: Solver or PDE search, for example 'Navier Stokes spectral'.

capabilities.name: Scientific Solver Evidence Report
capabilities.description: Retrieve a bounded evidence report for a validated Polymathica solver, including validation state/version, implementation source, evidence location, scope summary and registry-snapshot provenance.
